grandparents_cupboard.reason: Flour, butter, cheddar, eggs, milk, carrots and thyme are all ordinary home staples.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday Tesco item at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a bowl, grater, knife and baking tray, and rubbing in is a beginner technique.

works.reason: The egg, milk and moisture from the grated carrot should bind 350g flour into a soft dough, and 8 scones at 220°C for 15 minutes is right for a snack for four.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes covers grating, rubbing in and shaping, and the 15-minute bake matches the step.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Carrot scones suit an October afternoon, and the carrots lead the title and bulk out the dough.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are brief, plain British English that a beginner can follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: A savoury scone with carrot, cheese and egg is a real-food snack a family would happily make again.
